title: 祭りは準備が肝要ってな

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days have passed since Inari One's debut. I'm planning out her schedule going forward, when…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The hell's the matter with these girls?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ahh… That took some weight off my shoulders…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Boss. Didn't mean to startle ya. I had no idea what else to say.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Boss. Didn't mean to startle ya. I had no idea what else to say.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: After my debut… some of my classmates came lookin' for a chat.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Inari, I saw your debut race! You ran so well out there!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks! But this is just the beginnin'. My next race'll be even better!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Wow, you're so talented! No wonder you were able to transfer.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Hm?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: I know, right? After seeing her run, I knew she was too good for the regionals.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Your trainer scouted you, right? You're so lucky.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Inari? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, no… it's nothin'.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sorry. I just remembered I needa do somethin'. Catch ya later.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And thanks for watchin' my debut race! Bye!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Wha—Inari?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's what went down.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I couldn't stand listenin' to 'em anymore, so I came here.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whaddaya think about what they were sayin', Boss?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whaddaya think about what they were sayin', Boss?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Why're they talkin' as if I "stepped up" from the regionals to central?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Does everyone… look down on regional racing?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, that don't sit right with me at all. I won't stand for it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Nobody looks down on my crew! That goes for my old teammates and the regionals as a whole!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But you know what? I realized somethin' after transferring here.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The central races are big—way bigger than the regionals. Which means they draw in more spectators. That's a clear fact.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: My classmates were likely talkin' about that difference in scale. They weren't tryna be rude.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But still…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I won't let anyone say that our passions, our dreams, and our skills don't compare to what's in the centrals!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll scream it at the top of my lungs if I have to! But…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Bein' so fresh off my debut, no one's gonna listen to what I got to say. I think that's a given.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So… I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna really stand out in the Twinkle Series. Build up a huge reputation.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: If I don't have a voice right now, then I just gotta push through until I do!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And then, lemme tell ya, I'll be like the grand finale at the festival fireworks—too big and too loud to ignore!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Howzat sound? Startin' today, that's my new goal.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe, right? You 'n' me seem to be on the same wavelength.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe, right? You 'n' me seem to be on the same wavelength.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's the two of us, aimin' for the biggest stage to hold our biggest festival! That's where I'll stand tall! And then…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll let 'em all know that everyone down in Oi—heck, every racer in the regionals for that matter—has just as much fight as the central racers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that declaration, we finally have our goal—give the centrals a show they'll never forget!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later on, during our training session…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right, Boss, we've got a festival to plan! So, if we want this show to go off with a bang, what do I gotta do?
choice_data_list: Let's steadily improve your performance and gain more experience.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right, Boss, we've got a festival to plan! So, if we want this show to go off with a bang, what do I gotta do?
choice_data_list: Let's steadily improve your performance and gain more experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no need to strive for the top during her junior year. We should prioritize honing her skills and strengthening her body over gaining notable victories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to see her build real experience in the centrals. If she's to take on bigger challenges in the classic year, we need to start preparing now.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Okay, I see what ya mean! It takes a lotta prep to put on a huge festival.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right, let's switch lanes—from the road of tussles 'n' scraps to the highway of masterin' oneself!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Perfect! Now that we settled that, let's start trainin' already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With big hopes for the future ahead, our hot-blooded junior year begins!
